### 1. Error-detection data

```{r error-detection-data-cleaning-pipeline, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
clean_questionnaire_robust <- function(file_path) {
  df_raw    <- read_csv(file_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  df_subset <- df_raw %>%
    select(participant_id,
           question_id = stimuli_presented,
           answer      = response_value)
  df_wide <- df_subset %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = question_id, values_from = answer)
  df_wide %>%
    rename_with(~ paste0("quest_", .), .cols = -participant_id)
}

process_batch_error_detection <- function(batch_pattern, batch_label, folder_name) {
  message(paste("Processing:", batch_label, "..."))

  annotated_files <- list.files(
    path = "../data/annotated/",
    pattern = paste0(batch_pattern, ".*(FB|JB|HH)\\.csv"),
    full.names = TRUE
  )
  if (length(annotated_files) == 0) {
    warning(paste("  ! Skipping", batch_label, "- No annotated files found."))
    return(NULL)
  }

  target_folder <- file.path("../data/preprocessed", folder_name)
  quest_file    <- list.files(path = target_folder, pattern = "questionnaire_data.csv",
                               recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)[1]
  if (is.na(quest_file)) {
    warning(paste("  ! Skipping", batch_label, "- No questionnaire found."))
    return(NULL)
  }

  df_exp <- map_dfr(annotated_files, read_csv,
                    col_types = cols(.default = "c"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    distinct()

  df_exp <- df_exp %>%
    group_by(participant_id) %>%
    filter(any(!is.na(coder))) %>%
    ungroup()

  df_exp <- df_exp %>%
    mutate(
      comments         = as.character(comments),
      attention_score_8 = as.numeric(str_extract(comments, "(?<=\\()\\d+(?=\\/8)")),
      attention_score_7 = as.numeric(str_extract(comments, "(?<=\\()\\d+(?=\\/7)"))
    )

  failed_ids <- unique(c(
    df_exp %>% filter(attention_score_8 <  6)  %>% pull(participant_id),
    df_exp %>% filter(attention_score_7 <= 4)  %>% pull(participant_id)   # was == 4
  ))


  df_exp <- df_exp %>%
    mutate(attention_check_passed = !participant_id %in% failed_ids)

  df_quest_clean <- clean_questionnaire_robust(quest_file)

  df_exp %>%
    left_join(df_quest_clean, by = "participant_id") %>%
    mutate(batch_id = batch_label)
}

batch_manifest <- tribble(
  ~batch_pattern, ~batch_label, ~folder_name,
  "batch3",       "Batch 3",    "main_batch3"
)

df_raw_joined    <- pmap_dfr(batch_manifest, process_batch_error_detection)
df_clean_all_trials <- df_raw_joined %>%
  filter(attention_check_passed == TRUE) %>%

    ),

      err_reported_attempt == "secsame" ~ "Second Attempt (Same/Skip)",
      err_reported_attempt == "secdiff" ~ "Second Attempt (Changed)",
      TRUE                              ~ err_reported_attempt
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(err_reported_clean %in% c("y", "nans", "nun"))
```

#### 1.1 Exploratory / descriptive plots

```{r exploratory-plots, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
run_plotting_pipeline <- function(df_input) {

  error_type_labels <- c(
    "p"          = "Phon (Intended)",
    "p?"         = "Phon (Uncertain)",
    "np"         = "Non-Phon (Intended)",
    "np?"        = "Non-Phon (Uncertain)",
    "both"       = "Both Intended",
    "acheckp"    = "Attn Check (Pass)",
    "acheckf"    = "Attn Check (Fail)",
    "otherp"     = "Other Phon",
    "othernp"    = "Other Non-Phon",
    "otherfill"  = "Filler Error",
    "otherirr"   = "Style/Conciseness",
    "otherwrong" = "Wrong/Typo",
    "other"      = "Other"
  )

  df_input <- df_input %>%
    group_by(participant_id) %>%
    mutate(trial_num_sequential = match(question, unique(question))) %>%
    ungroup()

  df_analysis <- df_input %>%
    filter(stim_type == "target") %>%
    mutate(
      err_reported_clean = if_else(err_reported == "nanas", "nans", err_reported),
      condition = factor(condition,
                         levels = c("correct", "phon_err", "non_phon_err", "both_err")),
      err_reported_label = case_when(
        err_reported_clean == "nans" ~ "Question has no errors",
        err_reported_clean == "nun"  ~ "Unsure",
        err_reported_clean == "y"    ~ "Question needs correction"
      ),
      attempt_label = case_when(
        agrepl("first",   err_reported_attempt, max.distance = 1) ~ "First Attempt",
        agrepl("secsame", err_reported_attempt, max.distance = 2) ~ "Second Attempt (Same/Skip)",
        agrepl("secdiff", err_reported_attempt, max.distance = 2) ~ "Second Attempt (Changed)",
        TRUE ~ err_reported_attempt
      ),
      accuracy_label = case_when(
        no_err_response == "a"       ~ "Accurate",
        no_err_response == "w"       ~ "Wrong",
        no_err_response == "blank"   ~ "Blank",
        no_err_response == "corrected" ~ "Corrected",
        no_err_response == "twice"   ~ "Same Response Twice",
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(err_reported_clean %in% c("y", "nans", "nun"))

  df_trial_level <- df_analysis %>%
    group_by(participant_id, question, condition) %>%
    summarise(
      is_reported      = any(err_reported_clean == "y"),
      detected_phon    = any(err_reported_clean == "y" &
                               err_type_response %in% c("p", "p?", "both")),
      detected_nonphon = any(err_reported_clean == "y" &
                               err_type_response %in% c("np", "np?", "both")),
      final_label = case_when(
        any(err_reported_clean == "y")    ~ "Question needs correction",
        any(err_reported_clean == "nun")  ~ "Unsure",
        TRUE ~ "Question has no errors"
      ),
      trial_num = first(trial_num_sequential),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # (A) Was an error reported?
  plot_summary_A <- df_trial_level %>%
    count(participant_id, condition, final_label) %>%
    complete(participant_id, condition, final_label, fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
    group_by(participant_id, condition) %>%
    mutate(Total = sum(n), Prop = n / Total) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    group_by(condition, final_label) %>%
    summarise(Mean = mean(Prop, na.rm = TRUE),
              SE   = sd(Prop, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(ymin = Mean - SE, ymax = Mean + SE,
           err_reported_label = final_label)

  pA <- ggplot(plot_summary_A,
               aes(x = condition, y = Mean,
                   fill = err_reported_label, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.9), color = "white", width = 0.8) +
    geom_errorbar(position = position_dodge(0.9), width = 0.22,
                  color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.7) +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = c("correct"      = "Correct",
                                "phon_err"     = "Phonological",
                                "non_phon_err" = "Non-Phon",
                                "both_err"     = "Both")) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Proportion of Responses",
         fill  = "Participant Response",
         title = "Did participants report an error?") +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1))

  # (B) Hit Rate 
  plot_data_B <- df_trial_level %>%
    filter(condition != "correct") %>%
    group_by(condition) %>%
    summarise(
      phon_mean    = mean(detected_phon),
      phon_se      = sd(detected_phon) / sqrt(n()),
      nonphon_mean = mean(detected_nonphon),
      nonphon_se   = sd(detected_nonphon) / sqrt(n()),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -condition,
                 names_to  = c("Type", ".value"),
                 names_pattern = "(.*)_(.*)") %>%
    filter(
      (condition == "phon_err"     & Type == "phon")    |
      (condition == "non_phon_err" & Type == "nonphon") |
       condition == "both_err"
    ) %>%
    mutate(Type_label = if_else(Type == "phon", "Phonological", "Non-Phonological"))

  pB <- ggplot(plot_data_B, aes(x = condition, y = mean, fill = Type_label)) +
    geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.85), color = "white", width = 0.75) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se),
                  position = position_dodge(0.85), width = 0.22,
                  color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.7) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = error_colors) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = c("phon_err"     = "Phonological",
                                "non_phon_err" = "Non-Phon",
                                "both_err"     = "Both")) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Detection Rate", fill = "Error Type",
         title = "Hit Rate: Did participants detect the intended error(s)?")

  # (C) When was the error reported? 
  plot_data_C <- df_analysis %>%
    filter(err_reported_clean == "y", !is.na(attempt_label)) %>%
    mutate(
      reported_category = case_when(
        err_type_response %in% c("p",  "p?") ~ "Phonological",
        err_type_response %in% c("np", "np?") ~ "Non-Phonological",
        err_type_response == "both" ~ "Both",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      attempt_group = case_when(
        attempt_label %in% c("First Attempt",
                              "Second Attempt (Same/Skip)") ~ "First / Unchanged",
        attempt_label == "Second Attempt (Changed)"         ~ "Changed on 2nd Attempt",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(reported_category), !is.na(attempt_group))

  pC <- ggplot(plot_data_C, aes(x = reported_category, fill = attempt_group)) +
    geom_bar(position = "fill", color = "white", width = 0.7) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("First / Unchanged"       = "#7ABECC",
                                 "Changed on 2nd Attempt"  = "#F4A261")) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format()) +
    labs(x = "Reported Error Type", y = "Proportion",
         fill  = "Response Status",
         title = "When are errors reported?",
         subtitle = "Proportion of 'first/unchanged' vs. 'changed on 2nd attempt'")

  # (D) Accuracy when no error reported 
  plot_data_D <- df_analysis %>%
    filter(err_reported_clean == "nans", !is.na(accuracy_label),
           accuracy_label != "Other") %>%
    group_by(condition) %>%
    summarise(accuracy_prop = mean(accuracy_label == "Accurate"), .groups = "drop")

  pD <- ggplot(plot_data_D, aes(x = condition, y = accuracy_prop)) +
    geom_col(fill = "grey65", color = "white", width = 0.7) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = c("correct"      = "Correct",
                                "phon_err"     = "Phonological",
                                "non_phon_err" = "Non-Phon",
                                "both_err"     = "Both")) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Accuracy Proportion",
         title = "Trivia accuracy when NO error was reported")

  # (E) Error breakdown
  data_E <- df_analysis %>%
    filter(err_reported_clean == "y",
           !is.na(err_type_response), err_type_response != "NA") %>%
    filter(
      !(condition == "phon_err"     & err_type_response %in% c("np", "np?", "both")),
      !(condition == "non_phon_err" & err_type_response %in% c("p",  "p?",  "both"))
    )

  condition_totals <- data_E %>%
    filter(condition != "correct") %>%
    count(condition, name = "total_n_condition")

  plot_data_E <- data_E %>%
    filter(condition != "correct") %>%
    count(condition, err_type_response) %>%
    left_join(condition_totals, by = "condition") %>%
    mutate(P = n / total_n_condition)

  pE1 <- ggplot(plot_data_E %>%
                  filter(err_type_response %in% c("p","p?","np","np?","both")),
                aes(x = err_type_response, y = P, fill = condition)) +
    geom_col(color = "white") +
    facet_wrap(~ condition, scales = "free_x") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = condition_colors) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) str_wrap(error_type_labels[x], width = 10)) +
    labs(x = "Error Type", y = "Proportion",
         title = "Detailed Error Breakdown — Intended Errors Only") +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 40, hjust = 1))

  pE2 <- ggplot(plot_data_E,
                aes(x = err_type_response, y = P, fill = condition)) +
    geom_col(color = "white") +
    facet_wrap(~ condition, scales = "free_x") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = condition_colors) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
    labs(x = "Error Type", y = "Proportion",
         title = "Error Breakdown — All Annotated Responses") +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1))

  print(pA); print(pB); print(pC); print(pD)
  print(pE1); print(pE2)
}

run_plotting_pipeline(df_clean_all_trials)
```


#### 1.2 GLMER model fitting

```{r glmer-model-prep, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
build_long_df <- function(df_input, first_attempt_only = FALSE) {

  df_clean <- df_input %>%
    filter(stim_type == "target") %>%
    mutate(
      err_reported_clean = if_else(err_reported == "nanas", "nans", err_reported),
      condition = factor(condition,
                         levels = c("correct", "phon_err", "non_phon_err", "both_err"))
    )

  if (first_attempt_only) {
    df_clean <- df_clean %>%
      arrange(participant_id, question) %>%     
      group_by(participant_id, question) %>%
      slice(1) %>%
      ungroup()
  }

  df_trial_coded <- df_clean %>%
    group_by(participant_id, question, condition) %>%
    summarise(
      reported_phon    = max(if_else(err_reported_clean == "y" &
                                       err_type_response %in% c("p","p?","both"), 1L, 0L)),
      reported_nonphon = max(if_else(err_reported_clean == "y" &
                                       err_type_response %in% c("np","np?","both"), 1L, 0L)),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  df_phon <- df_trial_coded %>%
    mutate(ErrorType        = "Phon",
           Reported         = reported_phon,
           Present          = if_else(condition %in% c("phon_err",     "both_err"), 1L, 0L),
           OtherTypePresent = if_else(condition %in% c("non_phon_err", "both_err"), 1L, 0L))

  df_nonphon <- df_trial_coded %>%
    mutate(ErrorType        = "NonPhon",
           Reported         = reported_nonphon,
           Present          = if_else(condition %in% c("non_phon_err", "both_err"), 1L, 0L),
           OtherTypePresent = if_else(condition %in% c("phon_err",     "both_err"), 1L, 0L))

  df_long <- bind_rows(df_phon, df_nonphon) %>%
    select(participant_id, question, ErrorType, Reported, Present, OtherTypePresent) %>%
    mutate(
      Present_c          = Present          - 0.5,
      OtherTypePresent_c = OtherTypePresent - 0.5,
      ErrorType          = factor(ErrorType, levels = c("NonPhon", "Phon"))
    )

  # sum coding: NonPhon = +1, Phon = -1
  contrasts(df_long$ErrorType) <- contr.sum(2)

  df_long
}

df_long           <- build_long_df(df_clean_all_trials, first_attempt_only = FALSE)
df_long_first_att <- build_long_df(df_clean_all_trials, first_attempt_only = TRUE)
```


```{r glmer-fit, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
# Combined attempts 
m1 <- glmer(
  Reported ~ ErrorType * Present_c + ErrorType * OtherTypePresent_c +
    (1 | participant_id) + (1 | question),
  data   = df_long %>% filter(!(Present == 0 & OtherTypePresent == 0)),
  family = binomial
)
summary(m1)
sink("model_summary_both_attempts_main_batch3.txt"); summary(m1); sink()

# First attempt only
m1_att1 <- glmer(
  Reported ~ ErrorType * Present_c + ErrorType * OtherTypePresent_c +
    (1 | participant_id) + (1 | question),
  data   = df_long_first_att %>% filter(!(Present == 0 & OtherTypePresent == 0)),
  family = binomial
)
summary(m1_att1)
sink("model_summary_first_attempt_only_main_batch3.txt"); summary(m1_att1); sink()

# Extract p values automatically
extract_pval <- function(model, term) {
  s <- summary(model)$coefficients
  if (!term %in% rownames(s)) return(NA_real_)
  s[term, "Pr(>|z|)"]
}

fmt_p <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) return("N/A")
  if (p < .001) return("p < .001 ***")
  if (p < .01)  return(sprintf("p = %.3f **",  p))
  if (p < .05)  return(sprintf("p = %.3f *",   p))
  sprintf("p = %.3f (ns)", p)
}

# p-values for the two key effects
p_errortype_comb  <- extract_pval(m1,     "ErrorType1:Present_c")
p_otherpres_att1  <- extract_pval(m1_att1,"OtherTypePresent_c")
p_errortype_att1  <- extract_pval(m1_att1,"ErrorType1:Present_c")
p_otherpres_comb  <- extract_pval(m1,     "OtherTypePresent_c")

message("Key results:")
message("  ErrorType × Present  (combined attempts):  ", fmt_p(p_errortype_comb))
message("  OtherTypePresent     (attempt 1 only):     ", fmt_p(p_otherpres_att1))
message("  ErrorType × Present  (attempt 1 only):     ", fmt_p(p_errortype_att1))
message("  OtherTypePresent     (combined attempts):  ", fmt_p(p_otherpres_comb))
```

#### 1.3 Figures

```{r sdt-helpers, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
# SDT Helpers

build_sdt_long <- function(df_input, first_attempt_only = FALSE) {

  df_clean <- df_input %>%
    filter(stim_type == "target") %>%
    { if (first_attempt_only)
        arrange(., participant_id, question) %>%
          group_by(participant_id, question) %>% slice(1) %>% ungroup()
      else . } %>%
    mutate(err_reported_clean =
             if_else(err_reported == "nanas", "nans", err_reported))

  df_coded <- df_clean %>%
    group_by(participant_id, question, condition) %>%
    summarise(
      reported_phon    = max(if_else(err_reported_clean == "y" &
                                       err_type_response %in% c("p","p?","both"), 1L, 0L)),
      reported_nonphon = max(if_else(err_reported_clean == "y" &
                                       err_type_response %in% c("np","np?","both"), 1L, 0L)),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  bind_rows(
    df_coded %>% mutate(ErrorType = "Phonological",
                        Reported  = reported_phon,
                        IsSignal  = if_else(condition %in% c("phon_err","both_err"), 1L, 0L)),
    df_coded %>% mutate(ErrorType = "Non-Phonological",
                        Reported  = reported_nonphon,
                        IsSignal  = if_else(condition %in% c("non_phon_err","both_err"), 1L, 0L))
  ) %>% select(participant_id, ErrorType, IsSignal, Reported)
}

calc_sdt <- function(df_long_sdt) {
  df_long_sdt %>%
    group_by(participant_id, ErrorType) %>%
    summarise(
      hits   = sum(Reported == 1L & IsSignal == 1L),
      misses = sum(Reported == 0L & IsSignal == 1L),
      fas    = sum(Reported == 1L & IsSignal == 0L),
      crs    = sum(Reported == 0L & IsSignal == 0L),
      hit_rate = (hits + 0.5) / (hits + misses + 1),
      fa_rate  = (fas  + 0.5) / (fas  + crs   + 1),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      d_prime = qnorm(hit_rate) - qnorm(fa_rate),
      c_bias  = -(qnorm(hit_rate) + qnorm(fa_rate)) / 2
    )
}

sdt_att1 <- calc_sdt(build_sdt_long(df_clean_all_trials, first_attempt_only = TRUE))
sdt_comb <- calc_sdt(build_sdt_long(df_clean_all_trials, first_attempt_only = FALSE))

master_sdt <- bind_rows(
  sdt_att1 %>% mutate(Attempt = "Attempt 1"),
  sdt_comb %>% mutate(Attempt = "Combined (Attempts 1 & 2)")
) %>%
  mutate(Attempt = factor(Attempt,
                          levels = c("Attempt 1", "Combined (Attempts 1 & 2)")))
```

```{r fig2-masking, fig.width=11, fig.height=7, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}

# POSTER FIGURE 2 — Masking Effect
# Key finding: When a second error is added, detection of the first drops
# (significantly on Attempt 1; alleviated on Combined Attempts)

build_masking_long <- function(df_input, first_attempt_only = FALSE) {

  df_clean <- df_input %>%
    filter(stim_type == "target") %>%
    { if (first_attempt_only)
        arrange(., participant_id, question) %>%
          group_by(participant_id, question) %>% slice(1) %>% ungroup()
      else . } %>%
    mutate(err_reported_clean =
             if_else(err_reported == "nanas", "nans", err_reported))

  df_coded <- df_clean %>%
    group_by(participant_id, question, condition) %>%
    summarise(
      reported_phon    = max(if_else(err_reported_clean == "y" &
                                       err_type_response %in% c("p","p?","both"), 1L, 0L)),
      reported_nonphon = max(if_else(err_reported_clean == "y" &
                                       err_type_response %in% c("np","np?","both"), 1L, 0L)),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  df_phon <- df_coded %>%
    filter(condition %in% c("phon_err", "both_err")) %>%
    mutate(ErrorType = "Phonological",
           Reported  = reported_phon,
           Context   = if_else(condition == "both_err",
                               "Both Error Types", "Single Error Type"))

  df_nonphon <- df_coded %>%
    filter(condition %in% c("non_phon_err", "both_err")) %>%
    mutate(ErrorType = "Non-Phonological",
           Reported  = reported_nonphon,
           Context   = if_else(condition == "both_err",
                               "Both Error Types", "Single Error Type"))

  bind_rows(df_phon, df_nonphon) %>%
    select(participant_id, ErrorType, Context, Reported) %>%
    mutate(Context = factor(Context,
                            levels = c("Single Error Type", "Both Error Types")))
}

calc_masking_summary <- function(df_mask) {
  df_mask %>%
    group_by(participant_id, ErrorType, Context) %>%
    summarise(hit_rate = mean(Reported, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
}

mask_att1 <- calc_masking_summary(
  build_masking_long(df_clean_all_trials, first_attempt_only = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(Attempt = "Attempt 1")

mask_comb <- calc_masking_summary(
  build_masking_long(df_clean_all_trials, first_attempt_only = FALSE)) %>%
  mutate(Attempt = "Combined (Attempts 1 & 2)")

master_mask <- bind_rows(mask_att1, mask_comb) %>%
  mutate(Attempt = factor(Attempt,
                          levels = c("Attempt 1", "Combined (Attempts 1 & 2)")))

mask_means <- master_mask %>%
  group_by(ErrorType, Context, Attempt) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean = mean(hit_rate, na.rm = TRUE),
    SE   = sd(hit_rate, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

p_mask_att1 <- extract_pval(m1_att1, "OtherTypePresent_c")
p_mask_comb <- extract_pval(m1,      "OtherTypePresent_c")

stat_mask <- tibble(
  Attempt    = c("Attempt 1", "Combined (Attempts 1 & 2)"),
  group1     = "Single Error Type",
  group2     = "Both Error Types",
  p_label    = c(fmt_p(p_mask_att1), fmt_p(p_mask_comb)),
  y.position = c(1.05, 1.05)
)

p2 <- ggplot(mask_means,
               aes(x = Context, y = Mean,
                   color = ErrorType, group = ErrorType)) +
  geom_jitter(
    data   = master_mask,
    aes(y = hit_rate),
    width  = 0.06,
    height = 0,
    size   = 1.8,
    alpha  = 0.25,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(ymin = Mean - SE, ymax = Mean + SE, fill = ErrorType),
    alpha    = 0.18,
    color    = NA
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.8) +
  geom_point(size = 5, shape = 19) +
  stat_pvalue_manual(
    stat_mask,
    label        = "p_label",
    y.position   = "y.position",
    tip.length   = 0.015,
    size         = 5.2,
    bracket.size = 0.7,
    inherit.aes  = FALSE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Attempt,
             labeller = labeller(Attempt = c(
               "Attempt 1"                 = "Attempt 1 (Initial)",
               "Combined (Attempts 1 & 2)" = "Combined (After Re-exposure)"
             ))) +

  scale_color_manual(values = error_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual( values = error_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(),
                     limits = c(0, 1.15),
                     breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25)) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Single Error Type" = "Single\nError Type",
                               "Both Error Types"  = "Both\nError Types")) +

  labs(
    title    = "Resource Competition: The Masking Effect",
    subtitle = "Q2: Does adding a second error lower detection of the first?",
    y        = "Detection Rate",
    x        = NULL,
    color    = "Error Type",
    fill     = "Error Type",
    caption  = "Downward slope = masking (detection cost of adding a second error)"
  ) +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 5)),
    fill  = "none"
  )
```

### 2. Transcription data

```{r transcription-pipeline, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
mgsub <- function(pattern, replacement, x, ...) {
  result <- x
  for (i in seq_along(pattern))
    result <- gsub(pattern[i], replacement[i], result, ...)
  result
}

num.keywords.correct <- function(transcription, keywords) {
  keys  <- gsub("[[:punct:]]", "", tolower(as.character(keywords)))
  trans <- gsub("[[:punct:]]", "", tolower(as.character(transcription)))
  sum(!is.na(pmatch(unlist(strsplit(keys,  " ")),
                    unlist(strsplit(trans, " ")))))
}

check_keywords_correct <- function(transcription, keywords,
                                    global_row_id, filename, participant_id) {
  keys  <- gsub("[[:punct:]]", "", tolower(as.character(keywords)))
  trans <- gsub("[[:punct:]]", "", tolower(as.character(transcription)))
  keys.list  <- unlist(strsplit(keys,  " "))
  trans.list <- unlist(strsplit(trans, " "))
  data.frame(
    global_row_id  = global_row_id,
    participant_id = participant_id,
    Filename       = filename,
    keyword        = keys.list,
    is_correct     = keys.list %in% trans.list
  )
}

clean_questionnaire_robust_trans <- function(file_path) {
  d <- read_csv(file_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  if (!all(c("stimuli_presented","response_value") %in% names(d))) return(NULL)
  d %>%
    filter(stimuli_presented %in% c("exposure_spanish_accent","exposure_spanish")) %>%
    select(participant_id, question_id = stimuli_presented, answer = response_value) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = question_id, values_from = answer) %>%
    rename_with(~ paste0("quest_", .), .cols = -participant_id)
}

process_transcription_batch <- function(folder_name, group_label,
                                         batch_label, has_questionnaire) {
  message(paste("Processing Batch:", batch_label, "..."))
  target_folder <- file.path("../data/preprocessed", folder_name)

  trans_files <- list.files(target_folder, pattern = "transcription_data.csv",
                             full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)
  if (length(trans_files) == 0) { warning(paste("! No data for", batch_label)); return(NULL) }

  d_combined <- map_dfr(trans_files, function(f_path) {
    tmp  <- read_csv(f_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>% mutate(across(everything(), as.character))
    tmp$run_type <- if_else(str_starts(basename(f_path), "test_run"), "Test Run", "Official")
    tmp
  })

  key_file <- "../data/transcription_scoring.txt"
  if (!file.exists(key_file)) { warning("Key file missing"); return(NULL) }
  key.df <- read.delim(key_file, header = TRUE, sep = ",") %>%
    mutate(Sentence = as.character(Sentence))

  d.trans <- d_combined %>%
    filter(!is.na(stimulus_files_presented), stimulus_files_presented != "",
           block == "Transcription") %>%
    mutate(Filename      = basename(as.character(stimulus_files_presented)),
           Transcription = response_value)

  d.all.m <- merge(d.trans, subset(key.df, select = -c(SentenceSet)),
                   by.x = "Filename", by.y = "Sentence", sort = FALSE)
  if (nrow(d.all.m) == 0) { warning(paste("! Merge failed for", batch_label)); return(NULL) }

  d.all.m <- within(d.all.m, {
    Transcription <- tolower(mgsub(
      c("&lt&","&gt&","&quot&","&comma&","&semicol&","&pipe&","&apos&"),
      c("<",   ">",   '"',     ",",      ";",         "|",     "'"),
      Transcription))
    NumKeywordsCorrect <- mapply(num.keywords.correct, Transcription, Keywords)
    PropKeywordsCorrect <- NumKeywordsCorrect / as.numeric(NumKeywords)
  })

  d.all.m$quest_exposure_spanish_accent <- NA_character_
  if (has_questionnaire) {
    q_files <- list.files(target_folder, pattern = "questionnaire_data.csv",
                           full.names = TRUE, recursive = TRUE)
    if (length(q_files) > 0) {
      df_q <- map_dfr(q_files, clean_questionnaire_robust_trans) %>%
        group_by(participant_id) %>% slice(1) %>% ungroup()
      d.all.m <- left_join(d.all.m, df_q, by = "participant_id")
      if ("quest_exposure_spanish_accent.y" %in% names(d.all.m)) {
        d.all.m$quest_exposure_spanish_accent <- d.all.m$quest_exposure_spanish_accent.y
        d.all.m$quest_exposure_spanish_accent.x <- NULL
        d.all.m$quest_exposure_spanish_accent.y <- NULL
      }
    }
  }

  d.all.m$batch_id <- batch_label
  d.all.m$group    <- group_label
  d.all.m
}

batch_manifest_trans <- tribble(
  ~folder_name,         ~group_label, ~batch_label,   ~has_questionnaire,
  "transcrip_baseline", "baseline",   "Baseline",     TRUE,
  "main_batch3",        "main",       "Main Batch 3", TRUE
)

df_transcription_raw <- pmap_dfr(batch_manifest_trans, process_transcription_batch)

eligible_ids <- if (exists("df_clean_all_trials"))
  unique(df_clean_all_trials$participant_id) else
  unique(df_transcription_raw$participant_id)

df_transcription_all <- df_transcription_raw %>%

           "6df14d8680851e21a1bbe20d8e32fc04bc30979c5d654dc35ef36bc2910b9765") %>%
  group_by(participant_id) %>%
  mutate(trial_order = row_number()) %>%

print(df_transcription_all %>%

        summarise(N = n_distinct(participant_id)))
```

```{r transcription-plots, fig.width=10, fig.height=6, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
run_transcription_plots <- function(df_input) {

  summ_group <- df_input %>%
    group_by(batch_id) %>%
    summarise(stats = list(smean.cl.boot(PropKeywordsCorrect)), .groups = "drop") %>%
    tidyr::unnest_wider(stats)

  # Group comparison
  pts <- df_input %>%
    group_by(batch_id, participant_id) %>%
    summarise(M = mean(PropKeywordsCorrect, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

 p5 <- ggplot(summ_group, aes(x = batch_id, y = Mean, color = batch_id)) +
    geom_jitter(data = pts, aes(y = M),
                width = 0.12, alpha = 0.25, size = 2, color = "grey55") +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Lower, ymax = Upper),
                  width = 0.12, linewidth = 1.3) +
    geom_point(size = 6, shape = 19) +
    geom_text(aes(label = percent(Mean, accuracy = 0.1)),
              hjust = -0.45, fontface = "bold", size = 5.5) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Baseline" = "#777777", "Main Batch 3" = COL_NONPHON)) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
    labs(title    = "Accent Adaptation: Group Comparison",
         subtitle = "Mean keyword accuracy  |  Error bars = 95% bootstrap CI",
         y = "Mean Accuracy", x = NULL) +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

  # Hardest keywords
  df_input <- df_input %>% mutate(global_row_id = row_number())
  kw_df <- pmap_dfr(list(df_input$Transcription, df_input$Keywords,
                          df_input$global_row_id, df_input$Filename,
                          df_input$participant_id), check_keywords_correct) %>%
    left_join(df_input %>% select(global_row_id, batch_id), by = "global_row_id")

  hardest <- kw_df %>%
    group_by(keyword, batch_id) %>%
    summarise(P = mean(is_correct, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(batch_id) %>%
    arrange(P) %>%
    slice_head(n = 10)

  p6 <- ggplot(hardest,
                   aes(x = reorder_within(keyword, P, batch_id), y = P, fill = batch_id)) +
    geom_col(color = "white", alpha = 0.9) +
    scale_x_reordered() +
    facet_wrap(~ batch_id, scales = "free_y") +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Baseline" = "#888888", "Main Batch 3" = COL_NONPHON)) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
    labs(title = "Hardest Keywords by Group",
         x = NULL, y = "Proportion Correct") +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

  print(p5)
  print(p6)
}

run_transcription_plots(df_transcription_all)
```

```{r transcription-stats, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
run_adaptation_stats <- function(df_input) {
  df_stats <- df_input %>%
    mutate(batch_id       = factor(batch_id, levels = c("Baseline", "Main Batch 3")),
           participant_id = factor(participant_id),
           Filename       = factor(Filename))

  message("Analysis 1: Welch t-test (participant-level means)")
  df_agg  <- df_stats %>%
    group_by(participant_id, batch_id) %>%
    summarise(Mean_Accuracy = mean(PropKeywordsCorrect, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
  t_res   <- t_test(df_agg, Mean_Accuracy ~ batch_id, var.equal = FALSE)
  eff     <- df_agg %>% cohens_d(Mean_Accuracy ~ batch_id, var.equal = FALSE)
  print(t_res)
  message(paste("Cohen's d:", round(eff$effsize, 3)))

  message("Analysis 2: LMM  Accuracy ~ Group + (1|Participant) + (1|Sentence)")
  lmm <- lmer(PropKeywordsCorrect ~ batch_id + (1 | participant_id) + (1 | Filename),
               data = df_stats)
  print(summary(lmm))

  coefs <- fixef(lmm)
  slope <- coefs["batch_idMain Batch 3"]
  p_lmm <- summary(lmm)$coefficients["batch_idMain Batch 3", "Pr(>|t|)"]
  message(paste0("Baseline accuracy:   ", percent(coefs["(Intercept)"], 0.1)))
  message(paste0("Adaptation effect:   ", ifelse(slope > 0, "+", ""),
                 percent(slope, 0.1)))
  message(if (p_lmm < .05) "SIGNIFICANT" else "NOT SIGNIFICANT")
}

run_adaptation_stats(df_transcription_all)
```
